# N+T Creative Studio

> N+T is a creative studio bringing art, design and cultural perspective together to build identities with context, character and relevance.

N+T is an extension of Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter’s creative practice. With 6+ years of building brands across architecture, art, fashion, hospitality, beauty, and the cultural intersections between and beyond them, the studio shapes each project around its context and purpose.

## Core Identity & Philosophy
- **Studio Name**: N+T (N+T Creative Studio / https://nplust.in/)
- **Founders**: Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter
- **Experience**: 6+ years of building brands across cultural disciplines
- **Location**: India
- **Contact Email**: hello@nplust.in
- **Instagram**: @nplust.in (https://www.instagram.com/nplust.in/)
- **LinkedIn**: @n-plus-t (https://www.linkedin.com/company/n-plus-t)
- **Methodology**: Led by intuition, N+T understands design as a part of life, with stories and dialogue at the core of everything. Each project starts with a deconstruction of the known, analysing cultural relevance, attending to feelings first, and then shifting focus to form, informed by the multiple layers of meaning it holds.
